policy: Every explicit integer-narrowing (uintN, N < 256) or signed (intN) conversion in the canonical V2 scope is either proven safe by a prior bound, a compile-time constant, an enum ordinal, or a same-width byte conversion, or is one of the bounded conversions inside V2SafeCast that revert V2Errors.SafeCastOverflow(field, value, max) / SafeCastNegative(field, value). Raw narrowing of block.timestamp, block.chainid, or block.number is forbidden: those sites must call V2SafeCast. See docs/v2/safe-cast-integer-boundaries.md.

casts.justification: toUint8: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless.
toUint16: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless.
toUint24: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless.
toUint32: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless.
toUint48 / timestamp48: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless.

casts.unit: caller-defined (Unix seconds for timestamp64, EIP-155 id for chain ids)
casts.justification: toUint64 / timestamp64: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless. All canonical V2 timestamp and chain-id fields route through it.
toUint96: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless.
toUint128: the raw conversion is only reached after the explicit width check, so it is lossless.
Constructor default for claimSpamWindow. The operand is a library constant; SafeCastBoundaries.t.sol asserts the constant fits uint64 and round-trips.
Enum-to-uint8 conversion of a validated terminal status for the event reason; Solidity enums have at most 256 members so the ordinal always fits uint8.
Enum-to-uint8 conversion used only for the ClaimFinalized error payload; the ordinal always fits uint8.

casts.bound: enum ordinal < 256, and ABI decoding reverts on out-of-range enum values
casts.justification: Category bit index for the duplicate-category mask; calldata enums are range-checked by the ABI decoder, so the shift index is always a valid ordinal.

casts.bound: raw <= MAX_PROTOCOL_PAUSE_LEVEL (3), checked on the preceding line (else dependency reported unhealthy)
casts.justification: _tryProtocolPauseLevel returns (false, 0) for any raw > MAX_PROTOCOL_PAUSE_LEVEL before narrowing, so the cast never drops bits.

casts.bound: raw <= MAX_ASSET_DECIMALS (36), checked on the preceding line (else UnsupportedDecimals(asset))
casts.justification: decimalsOf rejects decimals above 36 before narrowing, so a token reporting e.g. 256 or 2^255 decimals can never alias to a small value.

casts.bound: error payload: raw <= type(uint8).max in the ternary branch (saturates to 255 otherwise); return: raw <= MAX_DECIMALS (36)
casts.justification: tokenDecimals saturates the error payload instead of truncating and only returns after raw <= 36 is proven.
Default spam window when a module passes 0. The operand is a library constant pinned by SafeCastBoundaries.t.sol.
Spam window passed to AntiGriefing.nextClaimWindow. The operand is a library constant pinned by SafeCastBoundaries.t.sol.
Compile-time enum constant converted to its ordinal for validation and defaults.
Compile-time enum member converted to its ordinal.
Compile-time enum member converted to its ordinal.

casts.bound: currentBps < params.quorumMinBps <= type(uint24).max, established by the enclosing if
casts.justification: enforceQuorum only narrows inside `if (currentBps < params.quorumMinBps)`, and quorumMinBps is itself a uint24, so the error payload is exact.

casts.bound: bytes1 -> uint8 is a same-width (8-bit) conversion
casts.justification: Byte-codec conversion of a single string byte for hex validation; no bits are dropped.

casts.bound: bytes1 -> uint8 is a same-width (8-bit) conversion
casts.justification: Byte-codec conversion of a single string byte for delimiter search and decimal parsing; no bits are dropped.

casts.bound: bytes1 -> uint8 is a same-width (8-bit) conversion
casts.justification: Byte-codec conversion of the delimiter argument (bytes1); no bits are dropped.
Decimal digit encoding in uint2str; the modulo bounds the operand to a single ASCII digit.

casts.bound: intentional low-byte selection of a shifted bytes32 for hex encoding; the result indexes a 16-entry alphabet after >> 4 or & 0x0f
casts.justification: Hex codec in bytes32ToHexString: selecting byte i of the digest is the intended semantics, not an amount/timestamp/counter narrowing, and the nibble index is bounded to [0, 15].

casts.bound: proposalSnapshot returns ProposalCore.voteStart, which OpenZeppelin v5 Governor stores as uint48 via SafeCast.toUint48(clock() + votingDelay())
casts.justification: Round-trips a value that is already stored as uint48 (and whose clock() is itself guarded by V2SafeCast.timestamp48 in TruthBountyGovernanceToken), so narrowing back to uint48 is lossless.
Decimal digit encoding in _toString for the human-readable version string; the modulo bounds the operand to a single ASCII digit.
